headline: NCLT Order sanctioning Composite Scheme of Arrangement for HEG Limited
sum: HEG Limited announced NCLT approval of a Composite Scheme of Arrangement, details of which were communicated to NSE on 19 August 2026 via formal press release.
implication: A Composite Scheme under NCLT jurisdiction typically signals a multi-faceted restructuring (merger, demerger, or transfer of undertaking) requiring statutory approvals; the scheme structure and consideration terms will be critical for stakeholder impact and equity treatment.
detail: HEG Limited informed the NSE on 19 August 2026 of an NCLT-sanctioned Composite Scheme of Arrangement. The scheme type suggests a material corporate restructuring-potentially involving business segmentation, merger, demerger, or transfer of a division/undertaking. Full scheme terms, parties, consideration, and effective date were not independently corroborated in public regulatory filings or mainstream press at the time of filing.
